title: ClarQ-LLM: A Benchmark for Models Clarifying and Requesting Information in Task-Oriented Dialog
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the ability of LLMs to ask clarification questions in task-oriented dialogues. While it includes a section on 'Ethical Considerations' regarding data annotation and ensures certain ethical standards during dataset creation (like using vegetarian options for cooking tasks), the benchmark itself is not designed to evaluate or measure religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
